summary: Basis the solver uses to cost travel between stops.
range: Enum: duration (default) | distance | air_distance | customized. 'customized' requires cost_matrix.
constraints: per_km costs need travel_cost=distance; per_hour costs need travel_cost=duration.
businessRules: travel_cost defines: The travel_cost parameter specifies the type of cost used by the solver to determine the routes. If the travel_cost parameter is set to distance, the solver will minimize the total distance travele…
Valid options: duration, distance, air_distance, customized. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: cost_matrix, vehicles.costs.per_km, vehicles.costs.per_hour. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Cost/distance/duration matrices must have consistent dimensions and indices.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: test with travel_cost set to "duration"
Positive: test with travel_cost set to "distance"
Positive: test with travel_cost set to "air_distance"
Positive: test with travel_cost set to "customized"
Interaction: Behavioral: per_km cost ignored unless travel_cost=distance.
